Claude 官方频道发布了一个约 22 分钟的访谈 ：Claude Code 团队的几位主要成员聊了他们日常开发工作，也回顾了这一年工作方式的变化

从写代码到推进产品目标...

过去，他们更多是给 Claude 一条具体指令，例如写一个函数，然后检查结果、提出修改意见。

现在，他们开始把更完整的工作交给 Claude：讨论产品方案、制作原型、编写代码、运行测试，甚至在工具投入使用后持续整理反馈。

有人过去喜欢钻研性能优化，有人曾用一天时间精细复刻 macOS Aqua 按钮的 CSS 渐变。如今，他们更愿意把这些具体实现交给 Claude，把精力投入新想法，让原型更快走向可用产品。

详细文字版：https://best.xiaohu.ai/article/claude-code-team-goal-workflows/

text: @aleabitoreddit Given that talk of an AI bubble burst is almost ubiquitous and inevitable, so it seems, curious on your thoughts/predictions of which companies you think are likely to survive/fair the best of/when it hits….?
@aleabitoreddit Day 12 of asking if you're still in Auros, Foci, Xintec, Shunsin and MssCorps

We just got AGI with Astra, so don’t quite think the AI burst is “ubiquitous and inevitable.”

Capex doesn’t seem to be slowing down, since there’s visibility into 2029-2031 with many semi companies now.

The segments at risk are probably the ones with leverage/financing risk, such as neoclouds or frontier labs with too many obligations.

Not the semi firms at 3-15 forward p/e who are raking in too much operating income a quarter.

I get like 100 of these types of questions a day, I can’t just answer all of them. 

Since you’ve asked 12 times: yes I still have exposure to all of them.

Cost averaged on a few, so as of today positions on:
Foci are up 53%
Xintec are up 53.1%

But still down -23% on Shunsin, -22% on Msscorp.

Main position I trimmed the most at a loss for tax harvesting was Auros after hybrid bonding industry delays.

I like to post thesis ideas, but try to keep portfolio management stuff private like tax loss harvesting or trimming.

I’ll post thesis research updates, like $TSM coupe confirming partnership with Shunsin. Or FAU bottleneck validation on Foci. Or hybrid bonding delays.

But in the end people should make their own decisions

It is less than a decade since the development of the transformer. 

Less than four years since the release of GPT-3.5 (ChatGPT).

Less than two years since the release of o1-preview (the first Reasoner).

quoted_tweet.author: Riley Brown
quoted_tweet.text:
Gemini is the only AI that can analyze videos quickly and accurately.

Gemini can watch full 30-minute videos, pay close attention, and analyze them in seconds. It can WATCH the video.

This is very useful for content workflows. The problem is that Gemini (right now) is not great at everything else. So at @agentnative_ we bundled that capability into a skill and gave it to Codex.

Our editors use this before they start editing, and it makes the process about 2x faster. Which is insane.
